relFeatures.description:
The features to plot. Each feature should have the id + name fields populated.
If plotActualValues is true, they should contain the feature description/expected sensor
to populate the legend description correctly.

Users of this spec must ensure the feature fields are populated, as the features will not be refetched.

assetId.description: The asset for which to get data

modelId.description:
If set, the contributions and reconstructions will be plotted for the given model. Feature data
will still be based on the given assetId.

plotActualValues.description: If true, the actual values of each feature will be plotted

plotReconstructions.description: If true, the reconstructions of each feature will be plotted

plotContributions.description: If true, the contributions of each feature will be plotted

scaleContributionsToRiskScore.description:
If set to true, and the `RiskScore` metric is being plotted for the given `modelId` or `assetId`,
the contributions will be scaled so that they add up to the risk score of the model or asset.
Only applies if plotContributions is true. In addition, the `Other Contributors` series will be added,
along with the `AddOtherFeatureContributorsTransform` to populate its data properly.
Note that running {@link ReliabilityFeatureUiHelper#addFeaturePlotting} with this set to true multiple times
is currently not supported.

Otherwise, the contributions will be plotted as lines.

orderYAxisFieldsBasedOnFeature.description:
If set to true, the `yAxisFields` in the chart configuration will be ordered based on the feature.
For each feature, its actual value, reconstruction, and contribution series will appear consecutively on the chart.

Note:
This option is automatically set to false when {@link #scaleContributionsToRiskScore} is set to true.
